title: Chapter 1359 - 29: Devouring The Chaos Void

Chapter 1359 - 29: Devouring The Chaos Void

Chapter 1359: Chapter 29: Devouring the Chaos Void

"It succeeded."

Lin Yuan felt joy in his heart.

He had arrived in this time loop world one hundred and fifty years ago.

Everything he did was for this moment.

To break the time loop.

To become a time life form.

And now it was completed.

Moreover, he had not used World-Breaking Origin Force to forcibly ’clear the level.’

Lin Yuan was naturally delighted.

The World-Breaking Origin Force was a last resort.

It was better to not use it if possible.

"The world is collapsing."

Lin Yuan overlooked the entire time loop world.

After passing the test, this world’s suppression of him quickly dissipated.

Even without relying on the perspective of replacing the world’s consciousness, Lin Yuan could easily look down from above.

Every detail of the entire time loop world was fully within Lin Yuan’s perception.

"Without the support of the supreme rules, everything has started to become illusory."

Lin Yuan thought.

This loop world was originally formed through the operation of the supreme rule dao.

Now that Lin Yuan had successfully passed the test, the supreme rule dao had withdrawn, and the world itself naturally ceased to exist, collapsing quickly like a bubble.

"Except for me."

Lin Yuan looked down at himself.

While everything else became illusory, only Lin Yuan was real.

This physical body, though a product of this world, had been refined by Lin Yuan over the hundred and fifty years with spirit runes, achieving a hint of true essence.

"And him."

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking towards the bottom of the endless deep sea.

That was where the original divine gold coffin was located.

The emperor of Da Feng who originally slumbered within had been annihilated by Lin Yuan using spiritual power.

But only reduced to the most microscopic particles, the particles themselves still existed, and some of them revealed a real state.

"As expected, this emperor of Da Feng, like me, also came from the outside world, not temporarily created by the supreme rule dao."

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

Having established the Greater Yan for eighty years, Lin Yuan had more or less understood the actions of this Da Feng emperor.

Especially towards the end, when finding the other inside the original divine gold coffin at the bottom of the deep sea, it was almost certain that this Da Feng emperor was not a life form within the time loop world.

Now it was possible to remove the ’almost,’ determining that he also came from the outside world.

"I just don’t know what reason brought him into this time loop world as the target of my test? Was it also to cross from the twelfth to the thirteenth layer?"

Lin Yuan faintly sensed that the other was not a twelfth-layer life form, but he wasn’t very sure.

After all, they had never fought, and their only meeting was just now when Lin Yuan, with the overwhelming momentum of replacing this world’s consciousness, annihilated him without holding back.

In truth, Lin Yuan had won with considerable difficulty.

There was even the possibility of failure when replacing the world consciousness at the end.

Even with the right timing and location.

It still couldn’t guarantee success.

This was considering that Lin Yuan could continuously observe future timelines through Rune Dao.

For an ordinary perfect twelfth-layer, falling into this loop world and facing the Da Feng emperor.

The only chance to pass the test and kill the opponent.

Was within twenty years before descending.

Recklessly infiltrating the palace, before the other released a substitute puppet to escape.

A fight to the death.

But this method held little hope.

Even Lin Yuan, as strong as he was after only twenty years of cultivation.

Charging into this world’s most heavily guarded Da Feng palace.

Could easily be exhausted to death.

And this was after Lin Yuan successfully passed the test, knowing all of Da Feng emperor’s tactics and layouts, gaining the only slight hope of passing the test.

Other perfect twelfth-layers couldn’t accurately predict the future; expecting them to gamble everything in just twenty years of the loop’s start?

No perfect twelfth-layer had that kind of nerve.

The more cautious a perfect twelfth-layer, the longer they would drag it out, waiting until their strength reached its peak before taking action.

Lin Yuan was such a person.

Yet if one truly did as such, it would essentially declare the time test a failure.

"Difficult."

Lin Yuan did a brief review and understood the difficulty faced in this time loop.

The supreme rule dao suppressed all means, including the technology Lin Yuan excelled in.

Even with the ability to observe future timelines, had he not established a power and detected Da Feng emperor’s ’details’ in time.

Lin Yuan might not have even attempted to replace the world consciousness with his own, ’seizing’ it, and instead continued purely to search for traces of the Da Feng emperor.

While Lin Yuan was contemplating.

The world’s collapse sped up.

Suddenly.

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

He could clearly feel that as the world collapsed.

He was faintly being stripped of an imprint, disappearing along with the world’s collapse.

Or rather, vanishing.

At the same time.

The supreme rule dao’s fluctuations instantly descended.

Briefly communicated with Lin Yuan.

"In this time loop, my experiences will be replicated, becoming a tribulation that other tribulation-claimers must pass through as an imprint?"

Lin Yuan’s expression turned a bit strange.

To put it simply—

The supreme rule dao considered Lin Yuan’s performance in this time loop to be excellent, therefore specifically condensing an imprint to serve as a tribulation for tribulation-claimers like Da Feng emperor?

Lin Yuan had considerable experience in this regard, having gone through it once before.

When transitioning from the Spirit Realm to the Immortal Realm, one had to ascend to the Nine Heavens, and the Ninth Layer of Heaven gathered the imprints of the ten strongest life forms in the Spirit Realm’s history; to enter the Immortal Realm, one had to defeat these ten strongest life form imprints.

When Lin Yuan ascended to the Nine Heavens, his own imprint became the last life form.

Also the strongest life form in the Spirit Realm’s history.

This led to millions and millions of years passing without a single Immortal King entering the Immortal Realm.
